question: How many male customers who were born between 1974 and 1976 have made a payment on their home in excess of $4000?

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.client_id)
FROM client AS T1
INNER JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.client_id
INNER JOIN loan AS T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id
WHERE T1.gender = 'M'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', T1.birth_date) BETWEEN '1974' AND '1976'
  AND T3.payments > 4000

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT COUNT(T1.client_id) FROM client AS T1
INNER JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.client_id
INNER JOIN account AS T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id
INNER JOIN loan AS T4 ON T3.account_id = T4.account_id
WHERE T1.gender = 'M'
  AND T1.birth_date BETWEEN '1974-01-01' AND '1976-12-31'
  AND T4.payments > 4000
